notes.title: Develop Brighton + Small Update(s)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, It's been a while...

Life, Studies, Develop:Brighton
I've been busy studying, travelling, and procrastinating, fortunately for me, one of those things has come to an end as I've now graduated (with a First Class grade)!

With graduating comes new opportunities; such as attending this games/tech conference known as Develop:Brighton. I will be tagging along with my university who are providing a stand to its students, allowing me to display B-B0 The Delivery Bot to attendees. If anyone happens to be attending too, It'd be lovely to see some faces.

I've also recently come back from a 2-week trip to Japan, a life-changing holiday ːjustchillingː .

The Update !
Anyway, let's get into this small update already ;

QoL

 Added a screen flash on player death. Makes it a whole lot easier to tell when/that you died lmao. The screen flash's colour is tied to the player's chosen colour (using the Colour System in settings).
 Fixed some UI bugs, visual and navigational (when using a controller).
 Slightly changed Level 9, the positioning of that LetterBot/Turret was awful.
 Added some more music + fixed the music randomly disappearing.
 Slightly increased the movement smoothing (time it takes for the player's movement to come to a halt)
 Changed bunnyhop mechanic to maintain momentum instead of decreasing momentum.


Balances

 Increased Player Ability duration from 1s to 1.5s
 Reduced DELIVERYTRUCK movement speed from 45 to 35.
 Reduced DELIVERYTRUCK (enraged) movement speed from 65 to 50.
 Reduced DELIVERYTRUCK (enraged) interval of packages thrown from 10 to 8.
 Increased DELIVERYTRUCK throw package delay from 0.5 to 0.6.


Co-Op

 Made 2 new levels that actually require cooperation (more coming soon).
 Added 1v1 mini-game mode, a little buggy atm though.
 Fixed the players being the same colour.
 Made jumping on each other's heads a lot easier.
 Improved co-op camera targeting, the camera now zooms out when players are far enough, ensuring each player can always see where they are.
 

I hope to bring more updates and content soon (and more consistently), for now though, enjoy this small package delivery from me.

Thank you for reading and or playing, I appreciate you all :),
malgow
